statement: Finite algebras over arbitrary henselian local rings with 2 invertible are semiperfect and admit exact idempotent and hermitian radical lifting without Noetherianity
notes: Two-sided Nakayama surjectivity replaces the Noetherian Hopfian step. Finite commutative monogenic subalgebras lift exact idempotents and selfadjoint square roots; finite matrix and corner endomorphism algebras give the full residue-form classification.

statement: Every effective coherent local base with finite or effective C1 residue has a henselization with ordinary canonical rational Om indices and complete split WG operations
depends_on: C:nonnoetherian-henselian-lifting; C:C1-henselization-WG; C:effective-henselian-DVR-WG; C:integral-orthogonal-coalgebras; Stacks0BSK; Stacks00UE; Stacks07QL
notes: The assumed full finite matrix-kernel algorithm on B computes annihilators and kernels on finite free monic-neighborhood algebras. Exact localization and faithful flatness give finite-name arithmetic and full B^h kernels. No Noetherianity or adic separatedness is imposed; all ring and form searches have proved positive termination.

statement: All effective valuation-domain henselizations with solved residue fields have ordinary complete WG algorithms including explicit equal and mixed characteristic lexicographic families outside flat Noetherian-stage limits
notes: Total computable divisibility gives finite Smith kernel algorithms. Explicit valuations on Fq(x1,...,xr) and Q(x1,...,x_{r-1}) supply all inputs. Their maximal ideals are principal yet x1 is nonzero in every power. Faithful flat ideal contraction and Krull intersection exclude any filtered flat local Noetherian-stage presentation.
